reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new temporal action: the man walks down the stone corridor, so the request governs action.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is supplied, so there is no reference medium to inherit; the schema pins medium ownership to the request.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference supplies observed clothing, so wardrobe remains request-governed rather than reference-governed.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies observed lighting, so lighting is governed by the request; no reference lighting can be retained.
reasons.framing: No visual reference supplies observed camera framing, and the explicit canvas aspect is not itself a framing instruction, so framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies an observed palette, so the scene palette is governed by the request rather than a reference.
